```{r}
filtered_data <- readRDS("../artifacts/filtered_data.rds")
codebook <- readRDS("../artifacts/codebook.rds")
gee_long_all_bx <- readRDS("../artifacts/gee_long_all_bx.rds")
gee_long_non <- readRDS("../artifacts/gee_long_non.rds")
gee_long_shared <- readRDS("../artifacts/gee_long_shared.rds")
source("../_common.R")
```

```{r}
library(janitor)
```

## 3. INFORMATION SHARING TASK

#### behavior summary, descriptives

```{r}
# descriptives for each type of information and intention
# Calculate mean behavior frequencies per participant
behavior_summary <- gee_long_all_bx %>%
  group_by(ResponseId, Behavior) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Behavior,
    values_from = total,
    values_fill = 0  # fill NAs with 0
  )

# View(behavior_summary)
```

```{r}
behavior_summary_info <- gee_long_all_bx %>%
  group_by(ResponseId, InfoType, InfoImportance, Behavior) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Behavior,
    values_from = total,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

```{r}
# Convert to long format
behavior_long <- behavior_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(shared, withheld, distort),   # specify behavior columns
    names_to = "Behavior",                 # name of the new column with behavior types
    values_to = "Count"                    # name of the new column with counts
  ) %>%
  group_by(ResponseId) %>%
  mutate(Prop = Count / sum(Count)) %>%    # calculate proportion of responses per person
  ungroup()

```

```{r}
behavior_long_info <- behavior_summary_info %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(shared, withheld, distort),
    names_to = "Behavior",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ResponseId, InfoType, InfoImportance) %>%
  mutate(Prop = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Using behavior_summary variable created earlier in the code
# How many participants did not distort anything at all? 

distortion_freq <- behavior_summary %>%
  count(distort) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  arrange(distort)

distortion_freq
```

### Zeros in cells, visualization of bx summary

```{r}
names(behavior_long)
```

```{r}
ggplot(behavior_long, aes(x = Count, fill = Behavior)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of instances",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Response type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# behavior_long %>% 
#   count(Behavior, Count)

behavior_long %>% 
  tabyl(Behavior, Count)
```

```{r}
names(behavior_long_info)
```

```{r}
behavior_long_info %>%
  group_by(InfoType, InfoImportance, Behavior) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(Count), .groups = "drop")
```

### zero across conditions, visualization

```{r}
# names(filtered_data)
```

```{r}
# Create data that has the UserID and the condition that they were in ONLY
condition_by_responseid <- filtered_data %>% 
  select(
    ResponseId,
    condition
  )

# Join the data together
behavior_long_condition <- behavior_long %>% 
  left_join(condition_by_responseid, by = "ResponseId")

behavior_long_condition %>% 
  tabyl(Behavior, Count, condition)
```

```{r}
behavior_long_info %>%
  mutate(info_condition = paste(InfoType, InfoImportance, sep = "_")) %>%
  tabyl(Behavior, Count, info_condition) %>%
  adorn_percentages("col")
```

```{r}
behavior_long_info %>%
  filter(Behavior == "distort") %>%
  group_by(ResponseId) %>%
  summarise(total_distort = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  count(total_distort)
```

### Checking cases with high distortion

4 cases chose to distort more than 5 items (2 cases at 6, 2 cases at 7)

```{r}
filtered_distort <- filtered_data %>%
  filter(ResponseId %in% c("R_1dac9ySUkwuAnbH",
                           "R_3qDudeTjdxqbqDz",
                           "R_2sbVAC7K53oMVCH",
                           "R_UbgFm6itImMChDX"
                           )) %>% 
  select(
          structure_number01,
          motivation_number01,
          Q14.1,
          SES_mean,
          hispanic,
          NeedCog_Mean,
          DirtyDozen_Narcissism,
          DirtyDozen_Psychopathy,
          DirtyDozen_Machiavellianism,
          SVO_angle
    )
```
